nodes.description: Public token name string stored in contract storage.
Public token symbol string stored in contract storage.
Token decimals, default 18, used as exponent when minting initial supply.
Total token supply; written in constructor, burn and burnFrom.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by _transfer, burn and burnFrom.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount; mutated by approve, transferFrom and burnFrom.
Constructor: mints initialSupply * 10**decimals to msg.sender and sets name/symbol.
Internal transfer routine performing balance checks and unchecked balance updates.
Public transfer from msg.sender to _to via _transfer.
Public transferFrom: checks and decrements allowance then calls _transfer.
Public approve: sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no constraints.
Public burn: destroys msg.sender balance and totalSupply.
Public burnFrom: burns _from balance using msg.sender allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, allowances, transfers and burns.
Unchecked multiplication initialSupply * 10**uint256(decimals) in constructor (arithmetic overflow).
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value inside _transfer.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value and totalSupply -= _value in burn.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value, allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value and totalSupply -= _value in burnFrom.
Constructor parameter: initial token supply before decimal scaling.
Constructor parameter: token name assigned to state variable name.
Constructor parameter: token symbol assigned to state variable symbol.
_transfer parameter: source address whose balance is debited.
_transfer parameter: destination address whose balance is credited.
_transfer parameter: amount moved between balances.
Local invariant in _transfer: sum of the two balances before mutation.
transfer parameter: destination address.
transfer parameter: amount to send.
transferFrom parameter: owner address debited.
transferFrom parameter: destination address.
transferFrom parameter: amount checked against allowance.
approve parameter: spender receiving the allowance.
approve parameter: allowance amount granted.
burn parameter: amount of caller balance to destroy.
burnFrom parameter: address whose balance is burned.
burnFrom parameter: amount burned and deducted from allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the address that receives the entire minted initial supply in the constructor.
initialSupply parameter is consumed by the constructor body.
tokenName parameter is written to the name state variable.
tokenSymbol parameter is written to the symbol state variable.
initialSupply is multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow protection.
Result of the unchecked multiplication is assigned to totalSupply.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply without validation.
Constructor performs the initial write of totalSupply.
_transfer contains the unchecked balance mutation operation.
_from parameter is read in balanceOf[_from] checks and updates inside _transfer.
_to parameter is validated and credited inside _transfer.
_value parameter drives the require checks and balance math in _transfer.
_value is subtracted from and added to balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Unchecked arithmetic writes the updated balanceOf entries.
previousBalances local captures the pre-transfer balance sum inside _transfer.
previousBalances is compared against post-mutation sums, so it depends on the unchecked arithmetic.
transfer delegates the state change to the internal _transfer routine.
_to parameter of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
_value parameter of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the actual balance movement to _transfer.
_from parameter is used for the allowance lookup and the delegated transfer.
_to parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
_value parameter is checked against allowance and forwarded to _transfer.
msg.sender is the spender index used when reading and decrementing allowance.
_value is subtracted from allowance with unchecked arithmetic.
allowance mapping entry is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
_spender parameter becomes the allowance key.
_value parameter is written as the granted allowance amount.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and only auth context in approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally.
_value parameter bounds the burn amount.
burn performs unchecked balance and totalSupply subtractions.
msg.sender determines whose balance is burned.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is decreased by unchecked arithmetic.
totalSupply is decreased by unchecked arithmetic.
_from parameter is the balance owner burned in burnFrom.
_value parameter is burned and deducted from allowance.
burnFrom performs unchecked subtractions on balance, allowance and totalSupply.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance authorizes burnFrom.
balanceOf[_from] is decreased without overflow protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decreased without overflow protection.
totalSupply is decreased without overflow protection.

normalization_plan.reason: initialSupply is a constructor parameter whose only significant sink is the unchecked multiplication that determines totalSupply.
tokenName is a constructor parameter directly stored into the name state variable by the constructor.
tokenSymbol is a constructor parameter directly stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor.
_from is a transient parameter of the internal _transfer helper and has no meaning outside it.
_to is a transient parameter of the internal _transfer helper and has no meaning outside it.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance arithmetic performed inside _transfer.
previousBalances is a local invariant value only used to assert the result of the unchecked balance updates.
_to is a transient parameter of the public transfer wrapper that merely forwards to _transfer.
_value is a transient parameter of the public transfer wrapper that merely forwards to _transfer.
_from is a transient parameter of transferFrom used only for the allowance lookup.
_to is a transient parameter of transferFrom forwarded straight to _transfer.
_value is the operand subtracted from the allowance mapping inside transferFrom.
_spender is a transient parameter used only as the allowance key in approve.
_value is a transient parameter written directly as the allowance amount in approve.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance and totalSupply subtractions in burn.
_from is a transient parameter identifying the burned account in burnFrom.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance, allowance and supply subtractions in burnFrom.
